name: Cresta
tagline: Generative AI for the contact center
description: Cresta is a generative-AI platform for contact centers offering real-time agent assist, virtual agents, and post-call analytics. Series D in November 2024 ($125M, ~$1.6B valuation) put it among the leaders alongside Sierra and Decagon for enterprise voice support deployments.
pricingDetails: Enterprise quote-based; per-seat plus feature-tier annual contracts.
